name: Bremelanotide (PT-141)
description: Synthetic ring-shaped 7-amino-acid peptide modelled on alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone

status.studiedFor: Low desire in women, ED in men
status.humanEvidence: Trials in women; small studies in men

note.lead: One trial in men was flagged.
note.text: The 2008 trial of 342 men from Iran carries an expression of concern. Studies in men used a nasal spray or injection.

bullets: **Activates melanocortin receptors;** MC1R and MC4R matter most (label)
**MC4R** sits on nerve cells across the brain
**MC1R** on skin pigment cells explains skin darkening
**How it works** for low desire in women is unknown (label)
Approved 2019 on 2 Phase III trials in women

practical.routes: Injection under the skin (label); nasal spray in early studies in men
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in about 1 hour; broken down by peptide hydrolysis
practical.monitored: Blood pressure, heart rate, skin darkening, nausea

regulatory.text: Approved 2019 for HSDD in premenopausal women

references: Safarinejad and Hosseini, J Urol, bremelanotide in ED, Mar 2008
Diamond et al., Int J Impot Res, PT-141 nasal spray, Feb 2004
